'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Kelly LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Kelly]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
